question: Where are Teide National Park and Garajonay National Park located?

steps.answer: Teide National Park is on Tenerife, Garajonay National Park is on La Gomera (both in the Canary Islands, Spain)

citations.claim: Teide National Park is located in Tenerife (Canary Islands, Spain)
